Marsh India expects the buyer-friendly market to persist, with companies using lower prices to secure broader coverage and higher limits.

banking-economy.title: Indian bank deposits jump by $115 billion over three fortnights to record high
banking-economy.summary: Indian banking system deposits have reached a record high after recent significant growth. This surge is primarily supported by dollar inflows into banks from a central bank scheme. The Reserve Bank of India's foreign-currency non-resident scheme attracted substantial foreign currency deposits. These inflows have helped boost overall banking system deposits to a new record level. Credit conditions are expected to remain strong as deposit growth continues.

sectors.summary: Voltas’ board approved a binding term sheet with Atomberg Innovation Private Limited on Friday, an exchange filing showed.
